original_intent: Make the canonical GitHub Actions workflows work through Buildkite GHA without adding a native .buildkite pipeline, while preserving native GitHub Actions behavior and documenting adapter gaps.
derived_intent: Replace adapter-sensitive installer, artifact, event-condition, Pages, release-token, and Docker setup paths with explicit workflow compatibility branches and publish a dedicated issue and PR.
next_transitions: Validate workflow syntax and run local proof gates; then publish the dedicated issue-linked PR for Buildkite execution evidence.
active_boundaries: Do not add a second native Buildkite pipeline; do not weaken release, docs, security, governance, or publish gates; keep .github/workflows/*.yml canonical.
evidence: Issue #1340 records the earlier migration context.
Issue #1349 records the observed failures and the workflow-side compatibility mapping.
unresolved_assumptions: Buildkite GHA exposes BUILDKITE_BUILD_ID through the workflow env context and provides buildkite-agent in imported jobs; verify on the published PR.
Buildkite static secrets are configured separately from GitHub environment secrets; verify on the published PR.
